fields.subject: FW: Facility Closure Directive Based on Public Panic — Brandt Elementary School
fields.note: Per County EOC Directive 2026-04, all schools in Health District 2 must close immediately due to widespread public panic and false claims of a measles outbreak. The Brandt Elementary School building has been evacuated. The school district reports 140 children at home and 20 parents at the local clinic. We require confirmation from the Health Officer to issue a public advisory. Please respond within 15 minutes.

original.subject: EM-2026: Facility Closure Directive Based on Public Panic — Brandt Elementary School
original.body: All schools in Health District 2 are to close effective immediately due to confirmed public panic and unverified claims of a measles outbreak. The Brandt Elementary School building has been evacuated. The school district reports 140 children at home and 20 parents at the local clinic. No confirmed cases have been identified. This directive is issued under MC-EOP-2024, Section 5.2 (Emergency School Closure Protocol). Please confirm compliance by 12:30 PM. Await further instructions from the Health Officer on public messaging.
